title: Holding an Employee Meal Account at More Than One Site
content:
An employee who works across more than one site may hold an Employee Meal Account at each of them, because a badge is registered against a site's tills and an employer funds each site's programme separately.

## The ceiling on accounts held

No employee holds more than the number of accounts printed against the meal plan at once, counting every account that is enrolled, active, restricted or suspended. No plan in this line prints more than 2, and on two of the six the number printed is 1.

| Meal plan | Accounts one employee may hold on this plan |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | 2 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | 2 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | 2 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | 2 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | 1 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | 1 |

A closed account does not count toward the ceiling, so an employee who has left a site and closed its account may enrol afresh on returning.

Plans written for a single account do not sit alongside a second account of any plan, so an employee moving onto one of those plans closes their other accounts first.

## Opening a second account at a site

A second account is never opened on the same plan at the same site; where an employee asks for one, the existing account at that site is used instead.

This is settled before an account is opened, and it is settled on the records rather than on what the employee says they hold: what counts is the employee and the site the new account would be opened against, read together, and the accounts already standing at that site on that plan in the enrolled, active, restricted or suspended states. Where such an account is found, it is that account's own reference that is used. Two accounts that are genuinely separate records differ in the day they were enrolled and in the site badge registered on them.

## Condition, judgement and result

| What the records show | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| An account on the same plan at the same site standing enrolled, active, restricted or suspended | A second account is not opened | The existing account at that site is used |
| An account on the same plan at the same site standing closed | That account does not count toward the ceiling | The employee may enrol afresh |
| Accounts at other sites within the plan's printed ceiling | Holding more than one account is allowed | An account may be held at each site |
